name: Harbor skinny Hermes fork
title: Maintain a replayable Harbor fork of Hermes Agent
description: Keep a minimal Harbor patch series on top of upstream Hermes tags, starting from v2026.5.16, so managed Harbor agents can use Harbor Engine and ~/.hw credentials without broad upstream divergence.

dependencies.contract: Harbor control-plane identity, workspace/org, billing, and credential expectations.
Long-lived local Harbor credentials under ~/.hw/credentials.json and ~/.hw/profiles/*.json.
Stage and production Anthropic-compatible model endpoint, supported model catalog, auth validation, and usage metering.
Managed agent deployment, VPS bootstrap, Slack integration, and Harbor Engine runtime wiring.

scope: Keep Harbor-specific changes narrow and easy to replay on new upstream tags
Use ~/.hw credentials as the source of Harbor auth instead of copying tokens into ~/.hermes
Route Harbor model and web-tool traffic through Harbor Engine
Expose only Harbor-supported models in Harbor managed/provider flows
Document upstream replay and version-tag procedures
out_of_scope: Raw provider-key routing for managed Harbor flows
Large upstream refactors that are not required for Harbor integration
done_criteria: Harness files explain Harbor fork mission, startup, versioning, replay, and verification rules
A local stage Engine smoke command can validate the Harbor model path using ~/.hw credentials without printing secrets
Future implementation work has a restartable feature state and dated handoff path
./init.sh passes, or exact blockers are recorded in a dated handoff
